attributes.name: sidebar_card_header_treatment
attributes.definition: How the heading or identity element at the top of a sidebar/secondary card is presented, in terms of accompanying visual elements.

values.definition: A circular avatar/photo paired with a bold name and subtitle (author/profile style).
Heading accompanied by a small illustration or line-art icon placed beside it.
Heading is text only, with no accompanying image.
No sidebar card or not applicable.

attributes.name: featured_card_content_structure
attributes.definition: The set and arrangement of content elements stacked within a featured/highlighted article card.

values.definition: Card stacks a category tag, headline, date, share links and a read-more link anchored near the bottom.
Card consists of an image, headline and short excerpt.
Card contains only a headline or minimal text.

attributes.name: profile_name_subtitle_typography
attributes.definition: Typographic pairing used for a person's name and descriptive subtitle in a card.

values.definition: Bold name paired with a serif subtitle.
Name and subtitle share the same typeface style.
